# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 25 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Property Tax & Costs

- **2027 property tax rebates confirmed for HDB and private homeowners** - HDB owner-occupiers will receive a 15% property tax rebate in 2027, while private residential owner-occupiers get 10%, capped at S$100 — reduced from the previous S$500 cap for private homes. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2027-property-tax-rebate-singapore/)

## HDB Market: Prices, Yields & Affordability

- **Jurong West 4-room flats post Singapore's highest HDB gross rental yield at nearly 8%** - Jurong West leads all HDB towns for 4-room flat rental yields at close to 8%, compared with an islandwide figure of over 6%. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-town-singapores-highest-rental-yield/)

- **Clementi 4-room resale flat sets new area record at $1.38M** - A 1,001 sq ft four-room flat at Block 445B Clementi Avenue 3 transacted at $1.38 million ($1,379 psf) in November 2026, the highest price recorded for a four-room resale flat in Clementi. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/clementi-crest-4-room-flat-sets-1-38m-record-at-1379-psf/)

- **ERA survey: two-thirds of Gen Z and Millennials plan to buy, but affordability and ABSD remain top obstacles** - ERA's 2026 Dream Home Survey found 66% of Gen Z and Millennial respondents intend to purchase a home and prefer larger spaces, with affordability, ABSD and property taxes cited as the main barriers. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/two-thirds-plan-to-buy-a-home-but-the-dream-home-has-to-fit-the-budget/)

## New Launches & Pricing Trends

- **New Serangoon condo three-bedder at $3.3M outprices larger Marina Bay Suites resale units** - A new three-bedder at Chuan Park in Serangoon achieved a median of $3.3M, above the $2.9M recorded for a larger Marina Bay Suites resale unit; all nine Marina Bay Suites repeat sales in the analysis recorded a loss. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/chuan-parks-new-3-bedders-at-s3-28m-cost-more-than-marina-bay-suites-s2-9m-resales/)

- **HDB announces new neighbourhood at Pasir Ris with public and private homes** - HDB has released plans for a new neighbourhood at Pasir Ris Neighbourhood 3 along Pasir Ris Drive 4, comprising a mix of public and private residential units. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/pasir-ris-new-neighbourhood/)
